name: @equin/plugin-framework-tooling-react-compiler-skips
description: The React Compiler's skips made visible: the react-compiler:no-silent-skips check runs the compiler over every browser-built module with the build's own options and fails on each component or hook it leaves uncompiled, unless the owning plugin declares the file exempt; and render-cost.ts, an e2e that counts what a skip re-renders on a real interaction.

holds.reason: The check runs the compiler through the same Babel the artifact builder does (web-artifacts holds @babel/core below 8 until the @vitejs/plugin-react 6 move, task-1793076072-gwttlf); the two lift together.
